dashboard.label: TextThreat Digital Well-Being Risk
dashboard.description: Splunk dashboard for TextThreat SIEM-ready digital well-being threat events.

search.query: index=textthreat event.module=textthreat | stats avg(digital_wellbeing.risk_score) as avg_risk | eval avg_risk=round(avg_risk,3)
index=textthreat event.module=textthreat | timechart span=5m avg(digital_wellbeing.risk_score) as avg_risk perc95(digital_wellbeing.risk_score) as p95_risk

index=textthreat event.module=textthreat | spath path=digital_wellbeing.harm_types{} output=harm_type | eval harm_type=coalesce(harm_type, 'digital_wellbeing.harm_types{}', 'digital_wellbeing.harm_types') | mvexpand harm_type | where isnotnull(harm_type) AND harm_type!="none_above_threshold" AND harm_type!="" | stats count by harm_type | sort - count
index=textthreat event.module=textthreat | stats count by source_platform | sort - count

index=textthreat event.module=textthreat | spath path=digital_wellbeing.harm_types{} output=harm_types | eval harm_types=coalesce(harm_types, 'digital_wellbeing.harm_types{}', 'digital_wellbeing.harm_types') | sort - _time | table _time text_hash harm_types digital_wellbeing.risk_score digital_wellbeing.confidence digital_wellbeing.model_version source_platform session_id

panel.title: Co-occurrence Candidates: Toxicity + Stress in Same Session Window

search.query: index=textthreat event.module=textthreat digital_wellbeing.risk_score>0.55 | spath path=digital_wellbeing.harm_types{} output=harm_type | eval harm_type=coalesce(harm_type, 'digital_wellbeing.harm_types{}', 'digital_wellbeing.harm_types') | mvexpand harm_type | eval is_toxicity=if(harm_type IN ("toxic","severe_toxic","obscene","threat","insult","identity_hate"),1,0) | eval is_stress=if(harm_type="stress",1,0) | bin _time span=30m | stats max(is_toxicity) as toxicity max(is_stress) as stress values(text_hash) as text_hashes max(digital_wellbeing.risk_score) as max_risk by session_id _time | eval cooccurrence_risk=min(max_risk+0.1,1.0) | where toxicity=1 AND stress=1 | sort - _time
